title: docs(skills): objectstack-i18n teaches the `books` translation group, with an eval for a two-language doc book
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96SYQWBK8w8rA6L8gYD1gU7)_

Fixes #26820

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-i18n` 技能的顶层分组清单补上 `books`(文档手册的书名、简介和各章节标题按读者语言显示),给出键的拼法;评测文件新增第 9 题(双语手册),并删去 5 句与技能正文重复的评测句子来付 token 账,余额按实测把该评测文件的上限从 1642 提到 1790。
- 为什么改:spec 已落地 `books` 翻译分组,但技能不教它,照技能写 zh-CN 包的 agent 会让文档侧栏停在英文,或把键错放到 `pages` 下。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、评测 JSON、棘轮一行和一条 changeset,无代码和 schema 变更;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`(第 169–181 行那一段)、`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`(第 9 题与 5 处删句)、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(该评测行的算式注释)。
- 两分钟验证:仓根执行 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期打印 82 个文件均在上限内、退出 0。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 为 Tier H,席位不会 ready、入队或开自动合并)。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: the "Top-level groups alongside `objects`" paragraph now names `books`, the group the spec added so a doc book's title and section titles follow the reader's locale. The entry spells the three keys the spec declares, read off `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (the `books` record) and `system/book.zod.ts` on `origin/main`: `books.{book}.label` / `.description` by `Book.name`, and `books.{book}.groups.{group_key}.label` by each group's stable `key`, never its position, with one spelled example (`books.crm_manual.groups.getting_started.label`). It says the pages themselves localize through `doc.translations` and that the inline `translations` map a book once carried stays retired (the `BOOK_TRANSLATIONS_RETIRED` prescription). The existing sentence "`os i18n extract --no-objects-only` scaffolds every group above but `messages` and `settingsCommon`" now covers `books` too, which is what `walkBooks` in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` does.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`: case 9, a two-language `crm_manual` book whose sidebar is still English. The ideal answer spells the book label and the `getting_started` group label by key and says `os i18n extract --no-objects-only` seeds them; `must_contain` pins `books`, `groups`, `getting_started`, `doc.translations`; `must_not_contain` pins `pages.crm_manual` (a key invented under `pages`) and `sections.getting_started` (the `sections` alias the spec points at `groups`).
- The eval file sat at its token ceiling (1642, headroom 0). Paid under the standing ruling recorded beside that row, quoted verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」.
  - **Cut first (227 bytes, 57 units, 6567 → 6340 bytes, 1642 → 1585):** five sentences that restated a rule the reader already reads elsewhere, each with its surviving home:
    1. case 1, "there is no ICU plural/select" (31 B) → `SKILL.md` "No ICU MessageFormat" section; the case's own `{count, plural` pin stays.
    2. case 3, "the retired `o.*` dialect is rejected on this door too" (56 B) → `SKILL.md` "The Retired `o.*` Shape" section; the case's own `o: {` pin stays.
    3. case 5, "`extract --check` is the separate freshness gate" (50 B) → `SKILL.md` "`os i18n extract --check` — freshness, not coverage" section.
    4. case 6, "inherited by every field referencing the picklist" (51 B) → `SKILL.md`'s `picklists` entry in the top-level group list ("every field referencing the picklist inherits them").
    5. case 8, "Neither is a `pages.*.components` key." (39 B) → the case's own `components.open_block` pin.
  - **Then the remainder:** case 9 adds 817 bytes = 205 units (6340 → 7157 bytes, 1585 → 1790). The row is pinned AT the measurement, `ceil(7157 / 4) = 1790`, zero headroom; the row comment in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` carries the same arithmetic.
- `SKILL.md` had headroom: 5485 → 5571 tokens against its ceiling of 6333 (stamp line excluded), so its row is unchanged.
- `.changeset/26820-i18n-skill-books-group.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch (the package's dist is built from `skills/**`).

No forced test edits: nothing but the eval JSON and the ratchet row changed outside `SKILL.md`.

## Tests

- Per-case cross-check over every case in the eval file, 9 cases: every `must_contain` string present in its own `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` string inside it — 0 violations. `JSON.parse` of the file succeeds.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 82 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) measured, not ratcheted.` (exit 0); `--self-test`: `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet self-test: 79 cases pass.` (exit 0).
- No package test or typecheck is owed: the diff touches no package source (`skills/**`, one ratchet row, one changeset), and no behaviour a test pins changed, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Skills readings (lines, then tokens as `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, the sibling gate's convention): `SKILL.md` 521 → 524 lines, 5485 → 5571 tokens (ceiling 6333); `evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` 85 → 95 lines, 1642 → 1790 tokens (ceiling 1642 → 1790); whole package, all 11 `SKILL.md` files: 4610 → 4613 lines, 56462 → 56549 tokens; whole `skills/` tree 19271 → 19284 lines.
- Not carried (noted, not filed): no shipped example bundle (`app-crm`, `app-showcase`) declares a `books` group yet, so the `SKILL.md` example is a spelled key rather than a line quoted from a shipped bundle, as the `inlineTitle` and report-block lines are.
- `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` are `@objectstack/spec` scripts (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`), not root scripts; the derived list names the former.

## Verification

All at head `cd559297`, on `origin/main` `7eb613c3` (the branch base; main had not moved when the list was derived).

- Derived gate list: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` printed 63 commands for this change set (4 paths, 63 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge threshold). Every one ran locally (the 8 dist-reading ones after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0, 7m26s), each exit code captured before any pipe: **63 of 63 exit 0**.
- Reconciliation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` → `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 63 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- Verdict lines worth reading: `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 82 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`; `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet self-test: 79 cases pass.`; `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 104 file(s) clean`; `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 21762 text file(s) …)`; `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1935 cases pass; 7 slow section(s) deferred.`
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: both `skills/**` paths hit clause ① (MANDATORY CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, no one-line exit), as the claim records.
- CI: the PR's own check-runs are the reading for every family CI runs; nothing was re-run locally to stand in for them.
